events.line: Veton, I don't know what the hell you did to anger the fantasy gods, but Tony Pollard just dropped a 35-point nuclear bomb on your projection and somehow you still look like a genius for once in your miserable season—don't get used to it.

Ilir, you absolute donkey—benching a guy who just dropped 20 points on your ass while he was rotting on your bench is the kind of move that gets you laughed out of this league for the next three years.

Jetmir, you absolute coward—benched Rhamondre for **20 fucking points** when you projected him for 10? That's not risk management, that's leaving money on the table and wondering why your team's broke.

Arben, you absolute coward—Blake Corum is out here putting up 16.6 points on your bench while you're probably starting some waiver-wire JAG who got you 2.8 in the flex, and for what? Your "gut feeling"? Your pathetic risk aversion just cost you a week you probably needed.

Rob, Jameson Williams just dropped 23.6 points on you and you still look like a genius for starting him—turns out even a broken clock is right twice a day, and somehow your clock actually works this week.
Ben, Caleb Douglas just put up 20 fucking points and you were apparently the only asshole in the league with the balls to start him—congrats on being accidentally genius, you absolute clown.
Rinor, you absolute coward—benched Vele when he was projecting for 8 and he comes back with 13.9? That's what happens when you don't have the balls to let your guys cook, you spineless bastard.
Faton Muriqi benched Tyler Shough, who scored 13.8 anyway.
Adam, you absolute coward—RJ Harvey just outscored his projection by 3.5 points on your bench while you started some JAG who probably got you 2 points, didn't you?

Adam, you absolute coward—benched Tucker Kraft while he put up 12.8 on your bench like some kind of fantasy confidence artist. That's what you get for overthinking a guy who clearly showed up to work this week.
